rows.title: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
rows.summary: Siti Networks Limited has informed that this is in continuation of our earlier communications (i.e. dated October 13, 2026), pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended from time to time ( Listing Regulations ), wherein we have informed that the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench ( NCLT ) vide order dated September 28, 2026 (received on October 12, 2026) has appointed Mr. Trupalkumar Patel (having IP Registration No. IBBI/IPA-001/IP-P01186/2018-19/11907) as Resolution Professional of the Company
